browser_qa.responsive_note: Realism milestone inspected at normal IAB widths 1034/1035 and height 669. Portrait/square/wide box fit is covered by the strengthened 4.15-unit field test; the earlier milestone additionally inspected the preserved widths above. No new mobile-device FPS claim.
browser_qa.reduced_motion: Code path disables gaze parallax and candle flicker and shortens pickup duration; preference emulation was not browser-tested.
browser_qa.hover_and_pointer_targets: Observed physical clicks for diamond, emerald, silver and loupe. Lamp drag changed reach/height; empty canvas does not turn jewelry.
browser_qa.lamp_drag: Pointer-ray intersection with the head’s z=-1 movement plane preserves grip offset; verified drag changed reach 48→82 and height 28→8 at the bounded lower limit.

live_qa.rollout_note: The first reload immediately after publication observed an old caption and one dynamic-module fetch failure during propagation. A subsequent normal reload loaded the new caption and full scene successfully; final hosted inspection passed.

browser_qa.png_export_note: 1035×669 CSS viewport, capped device pixel ratio 1.5; actual PNG is 1552×1003 pixels.

background_assets.maps: 1K photographed velvet color/normal/roughness/AO, wood/plaster maps, matching original table normal/ARM, two HDR panoramas

deployment.browser_handoff: Corrected hosted scene inspected; actual physical lamp drag passed after a normal reload. Original owner-private audience preserved.

limits: Tiger eye is an artist-tuned surface model, not measured volume optics
Loupe uses camera projection and a 3D eyepiece, not ray tracing through a designed optical lens
Live browser GPU, Rust CPU, and external Mitsuba outputs are credited separately
Pickup clearance uses conservative proxies and mounted-gem bounds, not general rigid-body collision physics
Faceted gem external rays sample a room cube probe; no near-field setting reflection, caustics or full scene path tracing
Alloy colors and dispersion/scattering parameters are artist tuned; not measured gemstone/alloy optics
Reflection capture refresh is limited to 10 Hz during lamp changes; frame rate has not been benchmarked on mobile

optics.diamond_mesh: Same Zsky Jewel 01 OBJ as Rust panel, CC BY 3.0, 21 facet planes
optics.emerald_mesh: Project step mesh repaired to closed convex hull, 42 facet planes
optics.dispersion: Three RGB refraction indices, not full spectral integration
optics.reflection_probe: 256-square half-float cube; cached max 10 Hz while dirty; main jewelry/loupe excluded; raw cube for faceted gems, explicit filtered material envMaps for main metal, tiger eye and ring samples. Room keeps its stable HDR environment.
optics.sample_case: Six artist-tuned metal presets × three finish rows = 18 rings
optics.msaa: Up to four samples in offscreen target

ring_drag_regression.cause: Jewelry moved to layer 1 for reflection capture exclusion, but pointer raycaster still used only layer 0. Keyboard/loupe movement worked and earlier QA missed direct bench dragging.
ring_drag_regression.fix: Bench intersection helper copies the viewing camera layer mask before testing targets.
ring_drag_regression.regression_test: Failed before mask synchronization; passes with jewelry on layer 1, ordinary foreground bench target on layer 0, and excluded layer 2 ignored.
ring_drag_regression.local_browser: Direct band drag visibly rotates jewelry and shows Turn the jewelry hover label.
ring_drag_regression.checks: 20 web tests, standalone build, Rust fmt, 98 Rust tests and strict Clippy; 12 original class hashes unchanged.
ring_drag_regression.hosted_browser: Passed: pointer drag from (604,379) to (720,402) visibly turns the band and stone; Turn the jewelry hover label present.

table_lighting_regression.cause: The 100 ms reflection-capture refresh replaced scene.environment globally, making table/room indirect light step at probe cadence and feeding captured room light back into itself.
table_lighting_regression.fix: Keep scene.environment at its original HDR environment. Bind the filtered moving capture only to jewelry materials; direct lamp/shadow changes continue on each relevant main draw.
table_lighting_regression.checks: 22 web tests including scoped reflection bindings and finish intensity preservation; standalone build; Rust fmt, 98 tests and strict Clippy; all 12 class hashes unchanged.
table_lighting_regression.performance_limit: Removed the 10 Hz environment-update dependency from room surfaces. No new GPU/device FPS benchmark or 60 FPS guarantee. Jewelry capture remains capped at 10 Hz.
table_lighting_regression.hosted_browser: Passed actual physical lamp drag after ready reload; changed direct lamp illumination and jewelry highlights with the separated room environment. No frame-time benchmark was performed.
table_lighting_regression.rollout_note: First immediate hosted load had a dynamic-module fetch failure during deployment propagation; a later normal reload loaded the corrected scene and hosted lamp drag passed.
